inputs.original_text: South African actress Terry Pheto has once again been drawn into controversy after new details emerged in Parliament linking her to alleged financial misconduct involving the National Lotteries Commission (NLC). The revelations were presented during a briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026. The session [...] The post Terry Pheto Linked To R20.56 Million NLC Funding Scandal In SIU Probe appeared first on SurgeZirc SA .
inputs.modified_text: A parliamentary briefing on 24 March 2026 linked Terry Pheto to an alleged R20.56 million National Lotteries Commission funding scandal now under SIU investigation. Public money is not a slush fund for the well-connected; it comes with a duty of stewardship, and those entrusted with it should face real scrutiny. The investigation must establish the facts, not trade in assumptions—but if responsibility is proven, influence and celebrity should offer no shelter. Equal justice and firm consequences are essential to public trust.
